description: The manifest is `sha256sum` output over the tracked files, one line per file, ordered by path compared byte by byte (`LC_ALL=C`), and the root is SHA-256 of the manifest bytes. The tree includes paths that a locale-aware collation orders differently.

cases.description: Sixteen files under two roots, listed here in no particular order. The paths mix upper and lower case, punctuation that sorts before and after "/", digits, a space, and a non-ASCII name. The manifest is ordered by path bytes. File contents include an empty file, CRLF line endings and every byte value.

sources: manifest: LC_ALL=C sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum over the files as written (macOS /sbin/sha256sum and shasum -a 256 agree)
root: sha256sum of the manifest file

rootMustNotBe: the root of the same lines ordered by Intl.Collator("en-US") (ICU in Node v24.3.0) and the root from LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 sort on macOS: examples of the locale-aware order SP-ATT-2 forbids
cases.notes: macOS `LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 sort` orders these paths differently from C

cases.description: One file. The manifest is one line ending in LF, and the root is the SHA-256 of that line.
sources: printf 'one file\n' | sha256sum, and sha256sum of the resulting one-line manifest
